description: One row per (country, indicator); one column per year. The mirror of the seed panel, which is one row per country-date and one column per indicator.

knowledge_time.rationale: The publisher issues an annual update, typically in the spring, covering through the previous calendar year. A lag measured from the end of the event's year therefore approximates when a figure first became available. It is a counterfactual for older years rather than a record of first publication - fidelity is modeled_lag, and per-release dates would be an upgrade to file_release. Column headers are bare years, so event_time is anchored to the year end; see docs/adr/0001 for why the end rather than the start.
